# Scenario content reference

*Generated by `scen/render_docs.py` from the code; do not edit by hand. Run `python3 scen/render_docs.py` after changing the code.*

Every list and number the scenario generator uses, from `scen/pools.py` (and the difficulty steps from `scen/steps.py`).
Enemy numbers are the calibrated Normal values; each scenario then varies them slightly (see Number variation).

## Enemies

Each scenario prints 6 minions, 3 minibosses (sorted by HP, picked with a d6: 1-2, 3-4, 5-6) and 1 boss.
Attacks are made in order and repeat; **H** is a heavy attack. The weak point is a pair of columns and a row.

### Bosses

Every boss has **420 HP** (less when it brings henchmen) and drops **12 gold**. Its weak point is one of 3·11 row 6,
4·10 row 5 or 5·9 row 6. It changes phase at two thirds and one third of its HP.

| Boss | Pattern | Attacks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The Iron Tyrant | Brute | 6, 6, 11H |
| Mother of Fangs | Venom | Venom 4, 6, Venom 4, 10H |
| The Pale Hex | Hexer | Daze 4, 6, 10H |
| Chainjaw | Grappler | Pin 4, 6, 10H |
| Warlord Kragg | Warlord | wind-up, 15H, 6, 6 |
| The Needle | Piercer | Sunder 5, 6, 10H |

### Boss phases

**Phase 2** gets a twist (d20: common 1-10, uncommon 11-16, rare 17-19, legendary 20) and, on a d6 of 4+, a pressure
(d20: common 1-11, uncommon 12-17, rare 18-20). **Phase 3** gets, on a d6 of 1-4, an opening (Exposed on a d20 of 1-18,
otherwise Cracked Shell) plus a pressure; otherwise a twist plus a pressure. Pin never takes a pressure, and Jinx and Plate
never pair with Fortify or Regenerate.

| Module | Kind | Rarity | Effect | Printed as |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Iron Wall | twist | C | Columns 6 and 8 blocked | Lock D,F |
| Shieldwall | twist | C | Columns 3 and 11 blocked | Lock A,I |
| Thick Hide | twist | C | Columns 3 and 11 deal 1 | Bulk 1 A,I |
| Trapper | twist | U | Two traps on your grid | Trapper 2 |
| Jinx | twist | U | 2 and 12 are not wild | Grapple |
| Plate | twist | U | Only columns 3 and 11 deal damage | Plate A,I |
| Gatehouse | twist | R | Columns 6, 7 and 8 blocked | Lock D,E,F |
| Daze | twist | R | Two pairs also fumble | Daze |
| Pin | twist | L | Only 2 runners | Pin |
| Doom | pressure | C | Heavy attacks +50% | Frenzy H |
| Fortify | pressure | C | Your attacks deal 3 less | Fortify 3 |
| Regenerate | pressure | C | Heals 4 each round | Regen 4 |
| Frenzy | pressure | U | All attacks +50% | Frenzy |
| Haste | pressure | R | Extra strike of 4 each round | Haste 4 |
| Berserk | pressure | R | Fumble counters deal 5 | Berserk 2 |
| Exposed | opening | C | Weak point 2 rows lower | Exposed 2 |
| Cracked Shell | opening | L | Columns 6-8 deal 1 | Fractured 1 D,E,F |

## Keywords

An enemy attack hits when the player takes damage from it, meaning guard did not block all of the damage.

- **Bodyguard**: The player must target this enemy before other enemies.
- **Daze**: Past the danger line, two pairs also fumble. Attack: on hit, the player is Dazed during the player’s next attack.
- **Pin**: The player has 1 fewer runner. Attack: on hit, the player’s next attack is Pinned.
- **Venom**: On hit, the player loses 2 HP at the start of each of the next 3 rounds, ignoring guard. Attack: X damage, Venom on hit.
- **Sunder**: Enemy attacks ignore half of the player’s guard. Attack: this attack ignores half of the player’s guard.
- **Thief**: Thief X: on hit, the player loses X gold.
- **Bulk**: Bulk X [columns]: specified columns deal X less damage per square to this enemy (minimum 0).
- **Fractured**: Fractured X [columns]: specified columns deal X more damage per square to this enemy.
- **Taunt**: Guard columns (D, E and F) deal 1 damage per square and give no guard.
- **Plate**: Plate [columns]: only specified columns deal damage to this enemy.
- **Trapper**: Trapper X: at the start of each player attack, place X traps: roll two dice for the column (re-roll 2 or 12) and one die for the row. A runner reaching a trap rolls a die: 4-6 evades and removes the trap, 1-3 ends the attack as a fumble.
- **Rally**: Rally X(Y): this enemy arrives with X extra minions and, when shown, Y minibosses, each rolled on a d6.
- **Lock**: Lock [columns]: specified columns cannot have runners.
- **Grapple**: Grapple [columns]: wilds (pairs totaling 2 or 12, and surges) cannot move runners in specified columns. With no columns, no wilds are available at all.
- **Frenzy**: All enemy attacks deal 1.5 times damage, rounded. Frenzy H: only heavy attacks.
- **Fortify**: Fortify X: player attacks deal X less damage to this enemy.
- **Regen**: Regen X: this enemy heals X HP each round.
- **Haste**: Haste X: each round, this enemy also strikes for X.
- **Berserk**: Berserk X: player fumbles deal X more damage to the player.
- **Exposed**: Exposed X: this enemy’s weak point is X rows lower.

## Map interactions

Pools are drawn by weight; a map with N chests prints 6 + (N - 1) treasure entries, and likewise for NPCs. Unique
entries appear at most once. **Surprise** damage depends on difficulty (see Difficulty).

### Quest requests

`[_,_]` means roll a cell. Quest pay depends on distance (see Map rules).

- Please save my cat from the tree at [_,_]
- I need elderberries from [_,_]
- My brother went to [_,_] and never came back
- Take this letter to the hermit at [_,_]
- I dropped my mother’s ring near [_,_]
- Light the old beacon at [_,_] for me
- Fetch clean water from the spring at [_,_]
- Scare off the crows nesting at [_,_]
- Leave this offering at the shrine at [_,_]
- Find my goat; it wandered off to [_,_]

**Stranded villager** (movement table): Villager, d6: 1-2 fight 1 minion, 3-4 fight 2, 5-6 escort them to [_,_].

## Exploration

### Movement roll

Roll 2d6 and add the quadrant's danger pips (doubles are read first: a miniboss, or once the fuse is lit, 1-1 or 6-6 is the boss).

| Roll + danger | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 3-5 | Nothing |
| 6 | Hidden treasure: STR to dig |
| 7 | Wandering trader |
| 8 | Stranded villager |
| 9 | 1 minion |
| 10 | Trap: DEX or take 4 |
| 11 | 2 minions |
| 12 | 3 minions |
| 13 | 3 minions, +1 to their attacks |
| 14+ | Miniboss and 1 minion |

### Fuses

Once the fuse is lit, a 1-1 or 6-6 movement roll brings the boss; when the danger track fills, the boss comes on the next roll.

| Fuse | Length |
| --- | --- |
| Danger 4 or more | short |
| Danger 6 or more | long |
| Opened 2 chests | medium |
| Visited all 4 quadrants | long |
| Talked to 2 NPCs | medium |
| Bought anything from a shop | short |

## Difficulty

Each tier changes the map's danger, fuse pool, track length, loops and surprise damage:

| Tier | Quadrant danger total | Fuses | Track length | Maze loops | Surprise damage | Target win rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Easy | 2 | long, medium | 16 | 25% | 3 | 80% |
| Normal | 3-4 | short, medium, long | 15 | 20% | 5 | 55% |
| Hard | 5-6 | short, medium | 14 | 15% | 7 | 30% |

Each map is then rated by simulation and given visible **difficulty steps** to hit its tier's target: whole steps of enemy
damage (up to ±3, about 0.53 log-odds each), then an enemy-HP fine-tune for the rest. Potions are not a lever: the
hero's inventory carries over, and balance is calibrated against a new hero's kit (6 gold, 3 potions, full HP).

## Objectives

Five per scenario, sized so each is met by about half of winning runs. R is the generator's estimate of movement rolls
in a run (fuse-aware); the constants are `OBJECTIVE_FIT`:

| Objective | Size |
| --- | --- |
| Take less than X damage before the boss | X = round(1.75 × R), at least 10 |
| Reach the boss at danger X or less | X = round(0.75 × track length), at least 5 |
| Open N chests | 2 if the map has 2 chests and R ≥ 8.2, else 1 |
| Defeat a miniboss / 2 minibosses | 2 if R ≥ 9.3 |
| Complete N encounters | N = round(0.88 × R), at least 3 |
| Talk to N NPCs | 1 / 2 / 3 for 1 / 2-3 / 4 NPCs on the map |
| Visit all 4 quadrants | fixed |
| Buy 2 items | fixed |
| Finish with X or more gold | X = round(0.95 × (expected earnings + 6)) |
| Defeat N minions | N = round(0.45 × R), at least 2 |
| Travel N cells | N = round(3.0 × (R + 2)), at least 10 |

Every scenario has one restraint objective (one of the first two) and one push objective; Buy and Finish-with-gold never appear together.

## Map rules

- **Map roll:** d6 + stat, **4** or more succeeds (`MAP_ROLL_TARGET`).
- **Quest pay by distance:** each scenario rolls its own table within 1-5 cells: 1-3 gold, 6-10 cells: 3-5 gold, 11+ cells: 5-7 gold (each band pays at least as much as the nearer one; `QUEST_PAY_RANGE`).
- **Escort** pays 3 gold (`ESCORT_PAY`); a successful **dig** finds 2 gold (`DIG_GOLD`); the movement-table **trap** deals 4 (`TRAP_DAMAGE`).
- **Shopkeeper** visits cost 0 danger; a new hero starts with **6 gold** and **3 potions**.

## Number variation

Each scenario varies its numbers around the tuned values, from its own seed stream (`JITTER`):

- Enemy HP ±10%, boss HP ±8% (phase thresholds follow).
- Each attack ±1 (heavy attacks stay at least 2 above normal ones; wind-ups stay 0).
- Enemy gold ±1 (at least 1), boss gold ±2.
- Treasure and NPC amounts (gain, take, heal), surprise and trap damage ±1.
- Shop prices ±1 per tier, each tier still pricier than the one below.
